name: Kevin's Natural Foods Roasted Garlic Chicken (Costco 2-Pack)
whyItWorks: Sous-vide chicken breast in a smooth roasted garlic chicken broth reduction. Roasting garlic breaks down raw allium fructans, making it far milder on the gut than raw garlic sauces.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm chicken in skillet and heat sauce until bubbly. Pair with smooth peeled mashed potatoes or white rice.
